title: This week's hottest physics papers on arXiv

sections.title: Observation of Universal Quantum Chaos at Shallow Depths
sections.abstract: The authors derive and experimentally test universal output-probability statistics in shallow chaotic quantum circuits, finding geometry- and boundary-dependent universality classes before full random-matrix behavior.
sections.claimed_result: Measured bitstring frequencies can expose scrambling, entanglement growth, and global fidelity through two effective parameters, according to the authors.
sections.caveat: The claims concern finite-depth circuits and device-specific noise; validation across hardware platforms and larger systems remains open.

sections.title: Optical Ion Clock with Engineered Immunity to Motion-Induced Frequency Shifts
sections.abstract: A spectroscopic interrogation protocol suppresses motion-induced frequency shifts in an ytterbium ion clock, reducing the measured combined fractional contribution from 1.3e-18 to 0.3e-18.
sections.claimed_result: The E3/E2 ratio constrains fractional temporal variation of the fine-structure constant to 2.4(2.7)e-19/yr, consistent with existing bounds, according to the authors.
sections.caveat: The fine-structure result is a limit consistent with zero, not a detection; residual systematic shifts remain part of the uncertainty budget.

sections.title: Probing the Metallicity Dependence of Fast Radio Burst Progenitors with CHIME/FRB Outrigger Dwarf Host Galaxies
sections.abstract: CHIME/FRB Outrigger localizations identify eight FRB host galaxies, including five dwarfs, and show statistically distinct metallicity distributions for repeating and apparently non-repeating bursts.
sections.claimed_result: Repeaters preferentially occupy lower-metallicity dwarf environments, while non-repeaters span more metal-rich hosts, according to the authors.
sections.caveat: The sample is small and selection/localization effects can bias host demographics.

sections.title: Cross-geometry transfer and model collapse in point cloud calorimeter shower generation
sections.abstract: A point-cloud diffusion model transfers between detector geometries with only 100 target showers, reducing its distance to Geant4 by about 51% relative to training from scratch while exposing model-collapse behavior.
sections.claimed_result: CaloClouds II adapts between detector geometries with limited target data, while recursive self-training shows model-collapse effects, according to the authors.
sections.caveat: The transfer experiment uses a specific source-target pair and 100 target showers; broader generalization remains open.

sections.title: Weak-Coupling Pair-Density-Wave from Momentum-Space Nonsymmorphic Symmetry
sections.abstract: A twisted-bilayer checkerboard model shows how momentum-space nonsymmorphic symmetry can make pair-density-wave superconductivity a leading weak-coupling instability and yield a topological spin-triplet state.
sections.claimed_result: Nonsymmorphic symmetry protects a finite-momentum Cooper logarithm over a broad doping range, according to the authors.
sections.caveat: The result is model-dependent and does not demonstrate PDW order in a material.

sections.title: Local Vacuum Entanglement through Most Entangled Modes
sections.abstract: The authors identify approximate profiles of modes carrying the largest vacuum entanglement between two disjoint spheres and propose a non-perturbative mode-swap harvesting protocol.
sections.claimed_result: Most-entangled modes provide a candidate operational decomposition of accessible vacuum correlations, according to the authors.
sections.caveat: The calculation uses a free field and spherical regions; interactions and operational feasibility are unsettled.

sections.title: Measuring Dual-Superconductor Length Scales in the QCD Vacuum at HERA
sections.abstract: Exclusive J/psi photoproduction data are fitted with a Clem-vortex profile to extract QCD-vacuum penetration and coherence lengths.
sections.claimed_result: Diffractive data can provide an empirical route to the two length scales of the dual-superconductor picture, according to the authors.
sections.caveat: The interpretation depends on the chosen dipole amplitude and vortex-profile model.

sections.title: AI-Accelerated Gyrokinetic Predictions of Turbulent Transport for Stellarator Design Optimization and Experimental Planning
sections.abstract: An AI surrogate trained on more than 200,000 nonlinear gyrokinetic simulations is used to optimize stellarator equilibria and accelerate transport-solver calculations.
sections.claimed_result: The surrogate enables direct optimization of radial turbulent-heat-flux profiles and critical gradients, according to the authors.
sections.caveat: Surrogate accuracy is bounded by the training distribution and the adiabatic-electron setup; optimized equilibria require validation.
